title: Boston Gas Company files a 365 Firm Day Transportation Service Agreement with Norwood Hospital. (Letter Order issued 2/27/98)
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department has determined that Boston Gas's proposed treatment of QFT revenues for GC 97-8, GC 97-12, and GC 97-16 is consistent with Department precedent for the Company. Therefore, the Department hereby approves the treatment of revenues as proposed by Boston Gas for the aforementioned agreements. Signed by: Janet Gail Besser, Chair; John D. Patrone, Commissioner and James Connelly, Commissioner.
Responses of Boston Gas Company to the Department first set of information requests numbered DPU 1-1 through 1-5. By: Thomas P. O'Neill, Counsel Boston Gas Company.
